profile.description: Established Adventure Zone outreach history. The limiting issue is the small festival footprint, not lack of interest in family entertainment.

notes.subject: Later history confirms footprint is too small
notes.body: Tanya Ishikawa declined Adventure Zone for 2024, but later 2025 Gmail history is more specific and controls the profile: RiverFest asked about lower-cost / low-power attractions, then said the festival grounds were simply too small and an Adventure Zone setup would occupy roughly a quarter or more of the event space. Adventure Zone acknowledged that limitation. Treat this as a structural space mismatch rather than continuing annual generic outreach.
